name: XcodeBuildMCP
description: Gives coding agents control of Xcode builds, tests, simulators, and physical devices for iOS and macOS, through an MCP server or a matching command-line interface.

skills.name: Build Xcode Projects
skills.description: Builds .xcodeproj and .xcworkspace schemes for iOS simulators, macOS, and physical devices by driving xcodebuild commands.

skills.name: Run And Prepare Tests
skills.description: Runs test suites on simulators or devices, and prepares portable .xctestproducts bundles with build-for-testing for later runs.

skills.name: Control iOS Simulators
skills.description: Boots simulators, installs and launches apps, captures runtime logs, and drives UI automation such as taps, swipes, and typing.

skills.name: Deploy To Physical Devices
skills.description: Installs and launches apps on connected iOS devices, which requires code signing to be configured in Xcode for the project.

skills.name: Discover And Scaffold Projects
skills.description: Lists schemes, targets, and build settings for a project, and scaffolds new iOS and macOS projects from built-in templates.
